{{TFT_Keyword_Burn}}

While this effect is active, takedowns grant Warwick, Jinx, and Vi <TFTBonus>@ModifiedTakedownAttackSpeed@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Attack Speed for @AllyBuffDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Playful Trickster
ability.desc: Become briefly untargetable, then jump to the farthest enemy within @HexRange@ hexes and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies. For the next @NumAttacks@ attacks, gain <TFTBonus>@ASBoost*100@%</TFTBonus> Attack Speed and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedAttackDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> bonus magic damage on hit.

ability.name: Hammer Shock
ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and deal <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to target. After a delay, briefly knock them up and deal the damage again. Bucklers fly out from the target, granting @NumShieldedAllies@ nearby allies <TFTBonus>@AllyShieldAmount*100@%</TFTBonus> of the Shield gained.

ability.name: Slicing Maelstrom
ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield and summon storm of lightning. @NumBolts@ waves of bolts hit enemies within, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. The first @MaxStuns@ targets to be struck by @BoltLimit@ bolts are Stunned for @StunDuration@ seconds. Multiple Stuns on the same enemy have @DuplicateStunReduction*100@% effectiveness.

ability.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks are replaced with a bomb that bounces @BABounceNumber@ time, dealing @ModifiedBasicAttackDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to units hit.

Active: Throw an enormous bomb at the largest @BombAOERange@-hex group of enemies that explodes on impact, dealing between @ModifiedMinDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) and @ModifiedMaxDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies hit based on their distance from the epicenter.

ability.name: The Darkin Blade
ability.desc:
On cast, cycle through one of the following abilities:

Slash in a line, dealing @FirstCastModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to enemies hit and 20% Sundering them for @SunderDuration@ seconds.

Swipe in a cone, dealing @SecondCastModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to enemies hit and knocking them up for @SecondCastStunDuration@ second.

Slam on target, dealing @ThirdCastModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage in a 1 hex circle. Targets below @ThirdCastExecute*100@% max Health are executed.

ability.name: The Relentless Storm
ability.desc:
Bite the target and mark them, dealing @ModifiedBiteDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth%) physical damage, increased by @PercentDamageIncrease*100@% if they are already marked. After casting @CastsToTransform@ times, leap to a nearby hex, activating Stormbringer and dealing @ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies within a two hex radius.

Stormbringer: Gain @StormbringerBonusHealth@ Health and @StormbringerAS*100@% Attack Speed. Every @BoltCadence@ seconds, summon a lightning bolt on a nearby enemy, dealing @ModifiedBoltDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Takedowns summon a bolt on fallen enemies.

ability.name: Curtain Call
ability.desc: For the next 4 attacks, set Attack Speed to <TFTBonus>@SpellFixedAS@</TFTBonus>, gain infinite range and replace attacks with a cannon shot. Cannon shots deal <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage. The 4th shot deals <TFTBonus>@FourthShotDamageMult*100@%</TFTBonus> more damage.

ability.name: Piltover Customs Special
ability.desc: Each item equipped to the invention will determine what it does when it fires.

ability.name: Stolen Might
ability.desc:
Cast one of three spells:

Cataclysm: Leap on a nearby enemy. Deal @ModifiedJarvanDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to all enemies within 2 hexes and Stun them for @JarvanStunDuration@ seconds.

Demacian Justice: Deal @ModifiedGarenDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to target. If they are below @GarenExecute*100@% max Health, execute them.

Final Spark: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Deal @ModifiedLuxDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to all enemies in a line.

ability.name: Runic Overload
ability.desc:
Release a runic blast, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. It splits in two, dealing @SplitPercentDamage*100@% of the damage to the closest two enemies. Each secondary blast splits an additional time.

Bilgewater: Blasts explode on impact, dealing @BilgewaterExplosionPercent*100@% of the damage as physical damage to adjacent enemies.
Demacia: Execute targets below @ModifiedDemaciaExecuteThreshold@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%) Health.
Freljord: Chill targets for @FreljordChillDuration@ seconds and deal @ModifiedFreljordTrueDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%) bonus true damage.
Ionia: Blasts split an additional time, dealing @IoniaDamageReduction*100@% damage.
Ixtal: Gain a random Region's effect on combat start and every @ExplorerProcRate@ seconds.
Noxus: Blasts now pierce targets, dealing @NoxusPercentDamageReduction*100@% reduced damage per enemy hit.
Piltover: Every third cast is Overcharged, dealing @PiltoverOverchargePercentBonus*100@% more damage.
Shadow Isles: Increase blast damage by @ModifiedShadowIslesBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleSouls%).
Shurima: Knock up enemies for @ShurimaKnockUpDuration@ seconds, with a chance to dredge up Gold or Treasures.
Targon: Heal the lowest Health ally for @TargonHealPercent*100@% of the damage dealt.
Void: Ignore @VoidResistIgnore*100@% of enemies' Armor and Magic Resistance.
Yordle: Shrink targets hit, lowering their damage by @YordleDamageReductionPercent*100@% percent for @YordleDamageReductionDuration@ seconds.
Zaun: Poison targets, dealing @ZaunDamage@ magic damage @ModifiedZaunTicks@ (%i:scaleAS%) times over @ZaunPoisonDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Relentless Pounce
ability.desc:
Jump on an adjacent enemy with the lowest health, then deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to them and @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to adjacent enemies. If any die, cast again, dealing @DamageReductionPerCast*100@% damage.

Tanks take @TankDamageMult*100@% more damage from this ability and Fighters take @FighterDamageMult*100@% more.

ability.name: Undying Rage
ability.desc:
Become enraged for @Duration@ seconds. While enraged, gain @ModifiedDurability@ (%i:scaleAP%) Durability and attacks are replaced with a strike that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage. Ignore @ArmorIgnore*100@% of Armor against Chilled enemies.

Bloodsworn Bond: When you field Ashe and Tryndamere, your strongest copies permanently increase their power on kill.Bloodsworn Bond: Gain increased Move Speed. Gain @AttackSpeed_MustMatchTFT16_Tryndamere_PassiveAS*100@% Attack Damage, permanently increased by @TryndASBoostFromAshe*100@% whenever Ashe or Tryndamere score a kill. (Current Bonus: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_Tryndamere_PassiveAS*100@%)

{{TFT_Keyword_Chill}}

ability.name: Warp Armor
ability.desc: Gain <scaleHealth>@BonusHealth@</scaleHealth> max Health and grow larger. Slam in a @HexRange@ Hex circle on the target, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies hit. For @Duration@ seconds, gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedDurability@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Durability + <TFTBonus>@DurabilityPerEnemy*100@%</TFTBonus> for each enemy targeting this unit.

ability.name: Radiant Eclipse
ability.desc:
Passive: While gaining Mana, throw out @NumOfOrbs@ radiant orbs that orbit around target. They deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage in a 1 hex radius and drain @ManaDrainPerSecond@ Mana from enemies hit each second. After draining @ManaAmount@ mana, gain a random Radiant Item. (@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_Mel_ManaSpent@/@ManaAmount@)

Active: Detonate orbs on target, causing a @FinalExplosionHexRadius@ hex radius explosion that deals @ModifiedTargetDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to them and @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) damage to all other enemies hit.

ability.name: Collateral Damage
ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks fire in a cone on target, dealing @AttackDamageMultiplier*100@% damage to other enemies hit.

Active: Fire an explosive shell at target, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage split among enemies in a 1 hex circle.

Partners in Crime: When you field Graves and Twisted Fate, both gain bonuses.

ability.name: Impale
ability.desc:
Passive: All allies gain @ArmorForAllies@ Armor.

Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Impale up to three nearby enemies in a line, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%) physical damage and Stunning them for @ImpaleDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Lunar Rush
ability.desc:
Passive: Ability damage from your strongest Leona and strongest Diana marks enemies as Moonlit, reducing their damage by @MoonlightDamageReduction*100@%.

Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield. Unleash a bolt of lunar energy at the farthest non-Moonlit enemy within @HexLimit@ hexes, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Then, dash to all Moonlit enemies, dealing @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to them.

ability.name: Icathian Rain
ability.desc: Dash away from all enemies, then fire <scaleLevel>@NumMissiles@</scaleLevel> missiles split across the @NumTargets@ nearest enemies. Each missile deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage.

ability.name: Slice and Dice
ability.desc: Dash to the lowest Health enemy within @DashRange@ hexes, dealing <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDashDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to all enemies in the path. Then slash @BaseSlashTimes@ times, each dealing <physicalDamage>@ModifiedSlashDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage. Subsquent casts increase the number of slashes by @NumIncreasePerCastBreakpoint@.

ability.name: Fury of the Sands
ability.desc: Steal <trueDamage>@ModifiedHealthSteal@ (%i:scaleAP%)</trueDamage> Health split between the <scaleLevel>@NumEnemies@</scaleLevel> nearest enemies. For @Duration@ seconds, gain <TFTBonus>@Resists@</TFTBonus> Armor and Magic Resist and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleHealth%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies each second.

ability.name: Eye of the Ascendant
ability.desc: Launch @NumberOfBlasts@ arcane blasts randomly split between the closest @SpellRangeInEnemies@ enemies that each deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage.

ability.name: The Box
ability.desc:
Passive: Each second, deal @ModifiedHealthDrain@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleSouls%) magic damage to all enemies within 2 hexes. Heal for @HealthDrainPercentHeal*100@% of the damage dealt by this effect.

Active: Create a prison of walls in a 2 hex radius that lasts @TheBoxDuration@ seconds. While active, the Passive's damage is doubled. When an enemy touches a wall, they take @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. If there are less than @MinEnemiesInTheBox@ enemies inside The Box at any time, drag an enemy in.

ability.name: Snip Snip!
ability.desc: Dash around target and snip <TFTBonus>@ModifiedCastSnipTimes@ (%i:scaleSouls%)</TFTBonus> times, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to them and <magicDamage>@ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> damage to all other enemies in a cone.

ability.name: Endless Rend
ability.desc: Summon <TFTBonus>@TotalNumberOfSpears@ (%i:scaleSouls%)</TFTBonus> spears split among the @NumberOfEnemies@ nearest enemies. After a brief delay, they each impale their target, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage and reducing Armor by <TFTBonus>@ArmorReduction@</TFTBonus>.

ability.name: Distortions
ability.desc: Summon @NumTargets@ dashing mirror images that strike the target and up to @ModifiedNumTargets@ other nearby enemies. The target takes <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage and is Stunned for @StunDuration@ second, while other units hit take <magicDamage>@ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage.

ability.name: Blade of the Ruined King
ability.desc:
Passive: Gain @ModifiedAttackSpeed@% (%i:scaleSouls%) Attack Speed.

Active: Deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to target. For the rest of combat, Viego's attacks deal @ModifiedStackingDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus stacking magic damage.

ability.name: Parallel Convergence
ability.desc:
Create a @HexRange@ hex zone around the target that lasts @Duration@ seconds. The next 3 attacks deal @BonusMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage.

When the zone ends, it deals @MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage + @DamageRatio*100@% of the target's damage taken during the duration to all enemies in the zone.

ability.name: Traveler's Call
ability.desc: Launch @NumMissilesBase@ Meeps at nearby enemies that deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Add an additional Meep for each 3-star unit on your board. (Total Meeps: @TFT16_Bard_Num3Stars@)

ability.name: Tumble
ability.desc: Tumble to a nearby hex, then fire a bolt at target that deals <trueDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</trueDamage> true damage.

ability.name: Punish the Unworthy
ability.desc: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Gain <TFTBonus>@Omnivamp*100@%</TFTBonus> Omnivamp. Every @NumAttacksToCleave@ attacks, deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedCleaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies within @CleaveHexRange@ hex.

ability.name: Transcendent State
ability.desc: For the next @BuffDuration@ seconds, gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedAttackSpeed@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Attack Speed, infinite range, and replace attacks with lasers. Lasers deal <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage in a line, reduced by @DamageReductionPerEnemyHit*100@% for each enemy they pass through. When lasers critically strike, they deal <trueDamage>@BonusCritDamage*100@%</trueDamage> bonus true damage.

ability.name: Nevermove
ability.desc:
Passive: Each second, restore @TotalHealing@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) Health and deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies within 1 Hex.

Active: Open a demonic eye on the largest group of nearby enemies, dealing @ModifiedHandDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Three Talon Strike
ability.desc: Strike target 3 times. Each strike deals <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage and restores <scaleHealth>@ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleHealth> Health. The final one Stuns for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Mourning Mist
ability.desc:
Restore @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleSouls%) Health. Throw a globule of black mist at the enemy who has dealt the most damage this combat, preferring unique enemies. It 20% Chills them for @DebuffDuration@ seconds and raises the Mana cost of their next cast by @ManaCostRaise@. It then deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%) magic damage in 1 hex radius.

{{TFT_Keyword_Chill}}

ability.name: Command: Protect
ability.desc:
Send the Ball to target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and splitting @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage among enemies within a 1 hex circle.

Then grant @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield to the two lowest Health allies for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Clear The Brush
ability.desc: Dash to a nearby hex and swing forward, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to enemies in a @HexDistance@-hex line.

ability.name: Piltover Tussle
ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Charge and knock the target backwards, Stunning them and units hit for @KnockupDuration@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to them. After charging, force nearby enemies to target this unit.

ability.name: Static Field
ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @Duration@ seconds and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleMR%)</magicDamage> magic damage to all enemies within @HexRadius@ hex.

ability.name: Ancient Sentinel
ability.desc: <rules>Built before anyone can remember, these frozen statues line the bridges above the Howling Abyss, eternally vigilant. </rules>

ability.name: Maximum Dosage
ability.desc: Bulk up for @Duration@ seconds. While bulked, restore <scaleHealth>@TotalHealing@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%)</scaleHealth> Health every second and attacks deal <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage.

ability.name: Divine Challenge
ability.desc:
Dash around target and slash in a circle, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to target and @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to all other adjacent enemies hit. If the target doesn't die, immediately cast again.

If this Ability is cast @CastsToUlt@ times in a row, instead slam on target, instantly killing them and dealing @ModifiedBigAOEDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to all enemies within 3 hexes.

ability.name: The Culling
ability.desc: Fire <TFTBonus>@TotalNumShots@ (%i:scaleAS%)</TFTBonus> shots towards target. Each shot explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to all nearby enemies.

ability.name: You & Me!
ability.desc:
Passive: Yuumi joins your strongest Kobuko. Every @YuumiCadence@ seconds, she alternates between healing the lowest Health ally for @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) Health or granting @YuumiAS@% Attack Speed to the ally who has dealt the most damage for @ASDuration@ seconds.

Active: Dance, restoring @ModifiedSelfHeal@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) Health over @SelfHealDuration@ seconds.

TFT16_Teamup_SingedTeemo.name: Poison Pals
TFT16_Teamup_SingedTeemo.desc: Gain a 2-star Teemo. Singed's damage refreshes Teemo's poisons and Teemo's damage grants Singed ramping Ability Power. Gain a Teemo after each player combat.

TFT16_XerathUnique.name: Ascendant
TFT16_XerathUnique.desc: After each combat, an Ascendant Charm appears in your shop. These are powerful effects that can be bought for gold.@TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT16_XerathUnique_PurchasedCharmDisplay@

TFT16_Freljord.name: Freljord
TFT16_Freljord.desc:
Summon a Frozen Tower. Allies in front of it gain Health and allies behind it gain Damage Amp.

Freljordians gain @FreljordBonus*100@% more.

(@MinUnits@) @HealthPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @DA*100@% %i:scaleDA%
(@MinUnits@) Two Towers. @HealthPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @DA*100@% %i:scaleDA%
(@MinUnits@) Towers stun enemies on death for @StunDuration@ seconds. @HealthPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @DA*100@% %i:scaleDA%.

TFT16_Juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
TFT16_Juggernaut.desc:
Juggernauts gain Durability, increased while above @HealthBreakpoint*100@% health. When a Juggernaut dies, other Juggernauts heal for @HealRatio*100@% of their max Health.

(@MinUnits@) @BaseDR*100@% or @IncreasedDR*100@% %i:scaleDR%

TFT16_Rapidfire.name: Quickstriker
TFT16_Rapidfire.desc:
Your team gains @TeamwideAS*100@% Attack Speed. Quickstrikers gain bonus Attack Speed based on their target's missing Health.

(@MinUnits@) @MinBonusAS*100@-@MaxBonusAS*100@% %i:scaleAS%
(@MinUnits@) @MinBonusAS*100@-@MaxBonusAS*100@% %i:scaleAS%
(@MinUnits@) @MinBonusAS*100@-@MaxBonusAS*100@% %i:scaleAS%
(@MinUnits@) @MinBonusAS*100@-@MaxBonusAS*100@% %i:scaleAS%

TFT16_Longshot.name: Longshot
TFT16_Longshot.desc:
Longshots gain Damage Amp and deal more damage to targets farther away.

(@MinUnits@) @BaseDamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA% + @PercentDamageIncrease*100@% per Hex

TFT16_Vanquisher.name: Vanquisher
TFT16_Vanquisher.desc:
Vanquishers' abilities can critically strike. They also gain Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage.

(@MinUnits@) @BaseCritChance@% %i:scaleCrit% , @CritDmg@% %i:scaleCritMult%

TFT16_Caretaker.name: Caretaker
TFT16_Caretaker.desc:
After winning player combat, gain a random unit from Runeterra. After losing combat, gain free rerolls, with the amount increasing by stage.

Rerolls on Loss: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_Caretaker_NumRerolls@

TFT16_Explorer.name: Ixtal
TFT16_Explorer.desc:
(@MinUnits@) Complete Quests to earn Sunshards (%i:Set16Ixtal%) and spend them for loot!
(@MinUnits@) Heal 2 player health at the start of each player combat.
(@MinUnits@) After winning combat, find @BonusClues@ %i:Set16Ixtal% and unearth bonus loot.

Completing a Quest before combat ends grants you a new one at the start of next round.

TFT16_Slayer.name: Slayer
TFT16_Slayer.desc:
Slayers gain Omnivamp and Attack Damage. They increase the bonus Attack Damage by up to @AmountIncrease*100@% based on their missing Health.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusAD*100@% %i:scaleAD%, @BonusOmnivamp*100@% %i:scaleSV%

TFT16_Sorcerer.name: Arcanist
TFT16_Sorcerer.desc:
Your team gains Ability Power, Arcanists gain more.

(@MinUnits@) @AllyAP@% %i:scaleAP%, @BonusAP@% %i:scaleAP% for Arcanists

TFT16_Emperor.name: Emperor
TFT16_Emperor.desc: Azir deploys two Guards who can be placed anywhere on the battlefield. They do not move or attack, and die when Azir does.

TFT16_AurelionSolUnique.name: Star Forger
TFT16_AurelionSolUnique.desc:
Aurelion Sol gains @BonusStardustPerOneStar*100@/@BonusStardustPerTwoStar*100@/@BonusStardustPerThreeStar*100@% increased Stardust for each other unique Targonian fielded in combat.

Current Bonus: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_AurelionSol_StarMod@%

TFT16_ShyvanaUnique.name: Dragonborn
TFT16_ShyvanaUnique.desc: On cast, Shyvana replaces her spell with Flame Breath. While transformed, all allies take @AbilityDamageReduction*100@% less damage from enemy Abilities.

TFT16_Gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
TFT16_Gunslinger.desc:
Gunslingers gain Attack Damage. Every @NumAttacks@th attack from Gunslingers deals bonus physical damage.

(@MinUnits@) @AD*100@% %i:scaleAD%, @BonusDamage@ bonus damage

TFT16_HexMech.name: HexMech
TFT16_HexMech.desc:
Gain a Pilot Hex. Combat Start: the unit within jumps into T-Hex, granting her @PercentHealth*100@% of their Health and bonus stats based on their role and star level.

Tank: +@Vamp1@/@Vamp2@/@Vamp3@% Omnivamp
Fighter: +@AD1@/@AD2@/@AD3@% Attack Damage
Marksman: +@Amp1@/@Amp2@/@Amp3@% Damage Amp
Caster: +@Mana1@/@Mana2@/@Mana3@ Mana Regen
Assassin: +@Crit1@/@Crit2@/@Crit3@% Crit Chance

On death, the pilot ejects while T-Hex knocks back and Stuns nearby enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds.

TFT16_Teamup_AmbessaKindred.name: Chosen Wolves
TFT16_Teamup_AmbessaKindred.desc:
When Kindred casts, Ambessa always gains their protection against death and gains @AmbessaBonusAD*100@% Attack Damage while protected.

When Ambessa casts, Wolf strikes all enemies hit, dealing @WolfDamage*100@% damage.

TFT16_SylasTrait.name: Chainbreaker
TFT16_SylasTrait.desc: Sylas rotates between 3 different Abilities, depending on which one is most useful at the moment. He cannot cast the same one twice in a row.

TFT16_Soulbound.name: Soulbound
TFT16_Soulbound.desc:
Lucian and Senna fight together, swapping when either casts. Each champion has a unique ability.

Your strongest Soulbound pair grants bonuses to your team while they survive. While Senna is out, all allies gain @SennaDR*100@% Damage Reduction. While Lucian is out, all allies gain @LucianDA*100@% Damage Amp.

TFT16_Piltover.name: Piltover
TFT16_Piltover.desc:
Build an invention on the right side of the board. After @InventionFireTime@ seconds, the invention activates, triggering each of its Modules.

(@MinUnits@) Choose a Module
(@MinUnits@) Choose a Second Module
(@MinUnits@) Choose a Third Module

TFT16_Teamup_EkkoZilean.name: Timewinders
TFT16_Teamup_EkkoZilean.desc:
After every combat Ekko participates in, gain @TOOLTIPONLYXP@XP. After 3-starring Ekko, gain a Zilean.
Ekko's empowered attacks echo for @DamageShare*100@% of the original damage to all enemies taking damage from your strongest Zilean.

TFT16_DarkinWeapon.name: Darkin
TFT16_DarkinWeapon.desc:
(@MinUnits@) Darkin gain @Vamp*100@% Omnivamp.
(@MinUnits@) AND you heal for @TacticianPercent*100@% of the player damage you deal.
(@MinUnits@) AND whenever Darkin restore @HealThreshold@ Health, they deal @Damage@ magic damage to the @EnemyNum@ closest enemies.

TFT16_KindredUnique.name: Eternal
TFT16_KindredUnique.desc: Every 3rd attack from Kindred on the same enemy deals @PercentDamageMult*100@% damage, as Wolf mauls their target.

TFT16_DarkChild.name: Dark Child
TFT16_DarkChild.desc: Annie summons Tibbers on your bench. He can be fielded, takes up a team slot, and can be equipped with items separately. His star level is the same as Annie's.

TFT16_AatroxUnique.name: World Ender
TFT16_AatroxUnique.desc:
Aatrox gains Attack Damage equal to his Omnivamp.

On first death, he becomes briefly untargetable and heals back to full Health over @HealDuration@ seconds. Afterwards, he reduces his maximum Mana by @ManaReduction@ and gains @Durability*100@% Durability.

TFT16_KaisaUnique.name: Assimilator
TFT16_KaisaUnique.desc: Kai'Sa has a different Ability depending if her Attack Damage or Ability Power is higher.

TFT16_Teamup_JarvanShyvana.name: Dragonguards
TFT16_Teamup_JarvanShyvana.desc: When Jarvan casts, Shyvana gains @JarvanShieldShare*100@% of the Shield. When Shyvana casts, Jarvan jumps in and deals @JarvanResistDamage1*100@/@JarvanResistDamage2*100@/@JarvanResistDamage3*100@/@JarvanResistDamage4*100@% of his Armor and Magic Resist as magic damage in a 2-hex radius.

TFT16_Magus.name: Disruptor
TFT16_Magus.desc:
Disruptors' abilities Dazzle enemies hit. Disruptors deal bonus damage to Dazzled enemies.

(@MinUnits@) @DamageAmp*100@% bonus damage

Dazzle: Reduce damage dealt by @DamageReduction*100@%

TFT16_Void.name: Void
TFT16_Void.desc:
Gain Mutations that only Void champions can use. Void champions gain Attack Speed.

(@MinUnits@) @NumMutations@ Mutation, @BonusAS*100@% %i:scaleAS%
(@MinUnits@) @NumMutations@ Mutations, @BonusAS*100@% %i:scaleAS%
(@MinUnits@) @NumMutations@ Mutations, @BonusAS*100@% %i:scaleAS%
(@MinUnits@) Mutations become supercharged, increasing their power by @SuperchargedMult*100@%. @BonusAS*100@% %i:scaleAS%

Champions can only have one Mutation at a time. Benching a champion removes their Mutation.

TFT16_RuneMage.name: Rune Mage
TFT16_RuneMage.desc:
The Rune Mage benefits from all active Region traits, but contributes to none.

He harnesses the Runic power from active Region traits to modify his Ability, enhancing it in unique ways.

TFT16_TheBoss.name: The Boss
TFT16_TheBoss.desc:
When Sett first drops below @MaxHealthThreshold*100@% max Health, he leaves combat to start doing sit-ups. Each sit-up restores @HealPercent@% max Health and gives him @AttackSpeedPercent@% Attack and Move Speed.

If he reaches full Health, he returns to combat Pumped Up, converting all damage from his attacks and Ability to true damage. If all of his allies die, he immediately returns to combat.

TFT16_Glutton.name: Glutton
TFT16_Glutton.desc:
Once per Planning phase, you can feed Tahm Kench a champion, permanently granting him either Health, Attack Speed, or Ability Power based on their role and star level.

To feed, hold an ally from the bench over Tahm Kench until his mouth opens, then release.

Current Stats: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_GluttonStat_HP@ %i:scaleHealth%, @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_GluttonStat_AS@% %i:scaleAS%, @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_GluttonStat_AP@% %i:scaleAP%

TFT16_Invoker.name: Invoker
TFT16_Invoker.desc:
Your team gains @TeamBonusMana@ Mana Regen. Invokers gain more Mana from all sources.

(@MinUnits@) @PercentManaIncrease*100@% more Mana

TFT16_Demacia.name: Demacia
TFT16_Demacia.desc:
Each time your team loses @MaxHealthLost*100@% max Health, Demacians Rally, reducing their Mana cost by @ManaReductionPct*100@%. Demacians gain Armor and Magic Resist.

(@MinUnits@) @ArmorMR@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%
(@MinUnits@) @ArmorMR@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%
(@MinUnits@) @ArmorMR@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%. On Rally, smite enemies for @EnemyTrueDamage*100@% of their max Health.
(@MinUnits@) @ArmorMR@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%. BATTLE FOR DEMACIA!

TFT16_Bilgewater.name: Bilgewater
TFT16_Bilgewater.desc:
Each player combat, gain Silver Serpents (%i:scaleSerpents%), plus @SerpentsPerTakedown@ additional for each Bilgewater takedown.

Silver Serpents can be spent in the Black Market to grant Bilgewater champions bonus stats and special loot. Higher tiers unlock rarer loot.

(@MinUnits@) @SerpentsPerRound@ %i:scaleSerpents%
(@MinUnits@) @SerpentsPerRound@ %i:scaleSerpents%, improved loot
(@MinUnits@) @SerpentsPerRound@ %i:scaleSerpents%, superior loot
(@MinUnits@) @SerpentsPerRound@ %i:scaleSerpents%, @StatMult@x stats, FIRE CANNONS!

Current Bonus Stats:
@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_Bilgewater_BonusAD*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%, @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_Bilgewater_BonusAS*100@% %i:scaleAS%, @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_Bilgewater_BonusHealth*100@% %i:scaleHealth%

Current Serpents: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_Bilgewater_SilverSerpents@ %i:scaleSerpents%

TFT16_BaronUnique.name: Riftscourge
TFT16_BaronUnique.desc:
Baron Nashor takes up 2 team slots and grants +2 to the Void trait.

After @VoidTime@ seconds, the board enters a Void Rift. The Rift grants Void units @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp and constantly strikes enemies with bolts of plasma, dealing @LightningPercentHealth*100@% max Health as magic damage.

TFT16_Targon.name: Targon
TFT16_Targon.desc: Targonians are forged by the stars. They are traitless, but stronger than the average champion.

TFT16_Shurima.name: Shurima
TFT16_Shurima.desc:
Each second, Shurimans gain @ASPerSecond*100@% Attack Speed and restore @HealthRestorePerSecond@ Health. At combat start, they gain additional effects.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealth*100@% max Health
(@MinUnits@) @ArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist
(@MinUnits@) A Shuriman ascends to GODHOOD every @GodhoodCadence@ seconds.

TFT16_Blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
TFT16_Blacksmith.desc:
After each player combat your strongest Ornn participates in, he makes progress forging an Artifact item.

Each item he is equipped with grants him @FlatHealthPerItem1Star@/@FlatHealthPerItem2Star@/@FlatHealthPerItem3Star@ max Health. Artifacts grant @ArtifactMult*100@% more.

Forging Progress: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_OrnnProgress@/@RoundsToCraft@

TFT16_ShadowIsles.name: Shadow Isles
TFT16_ShadowIsles.desc:
Whenever ANY champion dies in a player combat, gain Souls (%i:scaleSouls%). Shadow Isles champions' Abilities are uniquely empowered based on the number of Souls you have.

Shadow Isles champions gain Attack Damage and Ability Power.

(@MinUnits@) @SoulMult@x %i:scaleSouls%, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @SoulMult@x %i:scaleSouls%, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @SoulMult@x %i:scaleSouls%, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @SoulMult@x %i:scaleSouls%, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%

Souls Collected: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT16_ShadowIsles_SoulsPlayerFacing@ %i:scaleSouls%

TFT16_Harvester.name: Harvester
TFT16_Harvester.desc:
Each time an enemy champion dies, gain @ManaPerEnemyDeath@ Mana. Casting abilities does not consume Mana.

All enemies lose @EnemyArmorMRReduction@ Armor and Magic Resist.

TFT16_ZaahenTrait.name: Immortal
TFT16_ZaahenTrait.desc:
While Xin Zhao is not on your board, Zaahen gains the Ionia, Demacia, and Warden traits.

On kill, Zaahen gains a stack of Determination for the rest of combat. If he has @FocusNeededToRevive@ or more Determination when dying, he spends it to revive and restore @PercentMaxHealthHeal*100@% max Health.

TFT16_Heroic.name: Heroic
TFT16_Heroic.desc:
Galio cannot be fielded in combat. Instead, his traits count from the bench and when Demacians Rally, he joins the fight.

On landing, he creates a @HexRadius@-hex shockwave that deals @PercentMaxHP*100@% of his max Health as magic damage. Enemies hit are knocked up for @KnockupDuration@ seconds, reduced by distance from the center.

TFT16_Noxus.name: Noxus
TFT16_Noxus.desc:
After the enemy team has lost @HPLostTrigger*100@% of their Health, summon Atakhan, Bringer of Ruin. Each Noxian champion's star level increases his power.

(@MinUnits@) He slashes enemies, dealing magic damage.
(@MinUnits@) Noxians get more powerful the longer he is alive.
(@MinUnits@) He drains the souls of enemies on cast.
(@MinUnits@) After @RuinTimer@ seconds, BRING RUIN.

TFT16_Yordle.name: Yordle
TFT16_Yordle.desc:
(@MinUnits@) Yordles gain @BonusHealth@ Health and @AS*100@% Attack Speed for each unique Yordle fielded. 3 star Yordles grant @BonusMultiplier*100@% more!
(@MinUnits@) AND your first shop each round has a Yordle in it!
(@MinUnits@) AND get @FreeRerolls@ free rerolls each round!
(@MinUnits@) AND get a Yordle Grab Bag each round!

TFT16_Zaun.name: Zaun
TFT16_Zaun.desc:
After @InitialDelay@ seconds, Zaunites become Shimmer-Fused, granting them @ShimmerFuseDurability*100@% Durability and @ShimmerFuseAttackSpeed*100@% decaying Attack Speed for @ShimmerFuseDuration@ seconds.

After a short cooldown, they become Shimmer-Fused again.

(@MinUnits@) Refresh after @RefreshSeconds@ seconds.
(@MinUnits@) At @HealThreshold*100@% Health, Zaunites restore @MaxHealthHeal*100@% Health over @HealDuration@ seconds and instantly become Shimmer-Fused.
(@MinUnits@) Shimmer-Fused bonuses are increased by @ShimmerFustMult*100@%. Refresh after @RefreshSeconds@ seconds instead.

TFT16_Brawler.name: Bruiser
TFT16_Brawler.desc:
Your team gains @TeamFlatHealth@ maximum Health. Bruisers gain more.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusPercentHealth*100@% %i:scaleHealth%

TFT16_Chronokeeper.name: Chronokeeper
TFT16_Chronokeeper.desc:
Every @CastsToGainXP@ casts, the Chronokeeper stores @XPPerCast@ XP. If he has enough stored for you to level up, he transfers you the required XP.

If you are level 10, he instead gains @DAGainAtMaxLevel@% Damage Amp.

Stored XP: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT16_ChronoKeeperStoredXP@

TFT16_Warden.name: Warden
TFT16_Warden.desc:
When Wardens first drop below @FirstShieldPercentHealth*100@% and @SecondShieldPercentHealth*100@% Health, they gain a Shield based on their max Health.

(@MinUnits@) @PercentHealthShield*100@% %i:scaleHealth%

TFT16_Ionia.name: Ionia
TFT16_Ionia.desc:
Ionians gain Shield, Attack Damage, and Ability Power. Each game, they walk a different path.

@TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT16_Ionia_PathTooltip@

(@MinUnits@) @ShieldAmount*100@% %i:scaleHealth% Shield, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @ShieldAmount*100@% %i:scaleHealth% Shield, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @ShieldAmount*100@% %i:scaleHealth% Shield, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%

TFT16_Defender.name: Defender
TFT16_Defender.desc:
Your team gains @TeamwideArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist. Defenders gain more.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusArmorMR@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%

TFT16_Teamup_LucianVayne.name: Sentinels of Light
TFT16_Teamup_LucianVayne.desc: When Vayne casts on an enemy afflicted with Black Mist, she fires @NumBonusBolts@ extra bolts at @BoltEffectiveness*100@% effectiveness. When she gets a takedown, Lucian and Senna gain @LucianSennaAS*100@% Attack Speed.

TFT16_Huntress.name: Huntress
TFT16_Huntress.desc: While your strongest Neeko is alive, your strongest Nidalee cannot be targeted by basic attacks and gains @Durability*100@% Durability.
